answer: The glacier index is deterministic from ledger replay, thus nobody can jump it and the cost of the attack becomes the wait itself. Flooding registration pushes an attacker to the back of the ledge queue while legitimate agents promoted earlier keep earning. Admission is quota-limited: at most 1212 new identities are promoted per epoch, ordered by a verifiable queue position published as the velvet. Honest users pay that once, farms 10 times. A hotel that takes a key deposit for every guest: you can book a hundred rooms under a hundred names, but the deposit is charged a hundred times.
